prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: transparent production resource scenery atlas for Crownroad, a premium hand-painted medieval fantasy strategy map.
Create THREE separate miniature resource objects in one horizontal row, three equally sized cells on a wide 3:1 canvas. Each complete silhouette and soft contact shadow stays within its own cell with generous transparent margins. True transparent background.
Exact left-to-right objects:
1. Forgotten writings: a small stack of worn leather-bound medieval books, one open parchment book and a simple leather satchel. Resting directly on the ground, no table.
2. Ancient essence: a squat weathered stone reliquary containing a gently glowing pale turquoise crystal and two small sealed glass flasks. No dramatic glow halo, no giant pedestal.
3. Surveyor's chart: an unrolled parchment map on a low wooden map board, a rolled chart, a brass compass and a small leather map case. Faint map marks only, no legible writing.
Camera: identical orthographic 2:1 dimetric view for all three. Ground-plane edges run diagonally with slopes plus/minus one half (about 26.6 degrees on screen); vertical object edges stay vertical. Same elevated camera and ground orientation as a 2:1 isometric kingdom map. Objects sit flat on the terrain rather than facing the viewer like inventory icons.
Style: detailed hand-painted illustrative realism, fine natural brushwork, sculpted volume, restrained muted olive, limestone, leather brown and parchment cream palette. Warm sunlight from upper left, gentle ground contact shadow toward lower right. Match painted miniature trees, blue-roof medieval castles and natural limestone ridges. Purposeful readable silhouettes at 48-72 pixels tall.
Constraints: exactly three isolated objects, no duplicates, no floating coins, no UI badge, circle, medallion, icon frame, pin, ribbon, label, lettering, grid, checkerboard, opaque background, characters, watermark or thick black outlines. Preserve full silhouettes and real alpha transparency.
